## Historical Data

Daily metrics are stored in JSON files in this directory.

To analyze trends:
```bash
# View all metrics
cat .github/metrics/*.json | jq

# Plot star growth
jq -r '[.date, .stars] | @csv' .github/metrics/*.json
```
